# `aitbc operations ai status`

Get the status of one or all AI jobs.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations ai status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--job-id` | text | — | no | Specific job ID |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations ai status
```
